option_relations.rationale: The provided leaf 'Vaccination-related Arthritis' is a specific type of arthritis related to vaccination. 'Post-COVID-19 Reactive Arthritis' is a different condition, even if it might be triggered by a viral infection. There is no direct relation between the two.
Osteoarthritis is a degenerative joint disease. The provided leaf 'Vaccination-related Arthritis' is an inflammatory condition related to vaccination. These are distinct conditions.

Reactive arthritis (post-viral) is a type of arthritis that occurs after an infection. The provided leaf 'Vaccination-related Arthritis' is specifically related to vaccination, not a general post-viral cause, and thus not directly related.

Post-COVID-19 syndrome with osteoarticular and neurological manifestations describes a broader set of symptoms following COVID-19. The provided leaf 'Vaccination-related Arthritis' is a specific type of arthritis related to vaccination, not a general post-COVID syndrome.
